程序包 com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles

类 ParticleEffect

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.ParticleEffect
所有已实现的接口:
ResourceData.Configurable, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable
public class ParticleEffect extends Object implements com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable, ResourceData.Configurable
It's a set of particles controllers. It can be updated, rendered, transformed which means the changes will be applied on all the particles controllers.
